title: Fairness Metrics Report
description: A report documenting a risk-scoring model's error rates (false positive/negative, calibration) disaggregated by protected group, and the justification for any proxy variable used in place of the true outcome of interest.
evidence_description: A report giving a risk-scoring model's false-positive rate, false-negative rate, and calibration separately for each protected group tested, together with documentation of any proxy variable used and its correlation with protected characteristics.
collection_method: Statistical analysis performed by the model owner or an independent auditor against a representative labelled dataset.
retention_period: Minimum 3 years, and retained for the lifetime of the model version it was produced for.
artifact_format: PDF or structured report; underlying disaggregated statistics retained as a structured export (CSV/JSON).

citations.title: Dissecting racial bias in an algorithm used to manage the health of populations
citations.publisher: Science (American Association for the Advancement of Science)
